concept: 自解释断面语法 (Self-Explaining Cross-Section Grammar)
core_claim_zh: 断面语法的承诺：从几何约束生成治理要求——行人从断面图就能读出规则。此承诺可验证：视觉特征与行为规则必须一一对应、双向可推。
core_claim_en: The grammar's promise: rules generated from geometric constraints — pedestrians read the rule from the section. Verifiable: visual features must map one-to-one, bidirectionally, to behavior rules.
methodology_source_zh: 方法论来源：交通工程'自解释道路'（self-explaining roads）——让道路外观本身传达规则，无需额外标识。这是交通领域自己的方法论，是断面语法透镜的自然延伸。
methodology_source_en: Methodology source: traffic engineering's self-explaining roads — the road's appearance itself conveys the rule, no extra signage needed. This is the field's own discipline, a natural extension of the grammar lens.

sections.rule_summary_zh: 看见物理隔离+独立铺装的车道 → 知道是机器人专用、最快、行人不可进入
sections.rule_summary_en: Physical separation + distinct pavement -> robots only, fastest, no pedestrian entry

sections.rule_summary_zh: 看见蓝色色带+减速凸起 → 知道人机混行、速度较慢、机器人让行人
sections.rule_summary_en: Blue band + speed bumps -> mixed, slower, robots yield

sections.rule_summary_zh: 看见遗产铺装延续、无任何标记 → 知道这是步行空间、机器人随行、行人绝对优先
sections.rule_summary_en: Heritage paving, no markings -> pedestrian space, robots follow, absolute priority

sections.rule_summary_zh: 看见临时隔离+橙色警示 → 知道这是封闭测试、行人禁入
sections.rule_summary_en: Temporary barrier + orange warning -> closed testing, no entry
